mechanisms.source: Kirkpatrick et al., Introduction; complete canonical synthetic-data chapter read at 2e465a3a. Complete unchanged PPO owner read at 29efb9a8, including PPO-ptx in section 7.
mechanisms.reasoning: Weighted mean losses give the mixture gradient; the scalar conflicting-target example yields theta=2rho-1 and shows retention/adaptation trade-offs. Token/document/loss-bearing-token fractions, buffer coverage, repeated use and held-out old-task evaluation remain distinct.

mechanisms.source: Li, Grandvalet and Davoine, original ICML 2018 PDF, introduction and section 3, equations 1–3.
mechanisms.reasoning: An explicit pretrained-centred penalty has gradient lambda(theta-anchor), distinct from zero-centred L2 and AdamW decay. The two-parameter solution and detached anchor are checked. New classifier parameters do not acquire an unrelated source head anchor.

mechanisms.source: Kirkpatrick et al., arXiv 1612.00796v2, section 2 equation 3; Li et al., section 3 equation 4.
mechanisms.reasoning: Per-coordinate penalty gradients and the exact solution for supplied F=(9,.1) explain differential movement. Old/new constructed losses are calculated separately; coefficients are not misreported as measured Fisher estimates. A frozen-base LoRA counterexample changes output 1 to -1.

mechanisms.source: Li et al., categorical expectation below equation 4; Kunstner et al. 1905.12558v3, sections 1 and 4; Huszar 1712.03847v1 two-task and recursive Laplace derivations.
mechanisms.reasoning: Per-example squared score averages are separated from squared batch gradients and observed-label empirical Fisher. Values .25 versus 0 and .01 versus .09 are checked. Local diagonal approximation, normalization, anchor/precision memory and multi-task double counting are qualified.

mechanisms.source: Li et al., sections 4.2–4.3.2, complete Figure 2 and Table 3 on PDF page 6.
mechanisms.reasoning: Target-task accuracy plots do not replace the restored-old-head retention measure. ImageNet baseline 76.7 and drops 14.1/4.7/4.2 yield 62.6/72/72.5. The paper reports vision results; the chapter makes no LLM benchmark or guaranteed preservation claim.
